result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by faded crosswalk markings and a lack of continuous, well-maintained sidewalks. The intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signals and features wide, unprotected crossing distances, prioritizing vehicular movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface within the crossing area presents a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on the road shoulder or unpaved areas due to a lack of continuous walkways on the left side.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in a residential setting. However, visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked near the intersection corners obstruct the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground intersection near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve clarity for crossing pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, safety is limited by the lack of physical traffic calming and potential sightline obstructions from parked cars and corner vegetation.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the left side may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Corner vegetation
hazards.description: Dense bushes at the corner may block sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles making right turns.
hazards.location_in_image: Far right corner of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but is dominated by a large gas station apron that creates a wide, undefined conflict zone for pedestrians. While a traffic signal is present, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not visible, and there is no physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Gas Station Apron
hazards.description: The large, open driveway for the gas station creates a wide conflict zone where vehicles can cross the sidewalk at various angles and speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner adjacent to the gas station

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks visible pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light pole on the corner

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information and improve crossing safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Bollards
interventions.description: Use bollards or curb extensions to better define the pedestrian path and narrow the vehicle entry points to the gas station, reducing the conflict area.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicle traffic gets a green light, increasing visibility.
